title: EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging

triage.reason: The Commission has launched a new active initiative (Ares(2026)9620334) for a regulation on biobased feedstock targets and requirements in plastic packaging, the follow-up foreseen under the PPWR's biobased feedstock review, with feedback opening 19 October 2026.

draft.summary: A planned regulation on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging, reference Ares(2026)9620334, is listed with an active initiative status and a front-end stage of 'INIT_PLANNED'. Receiving feedback is disabled, and the listed feedback start date is 19 October 2026.

reference: Ares(2026)9620334

draft.interpretation: A separate proposal on biobased feedstock requirements would add a further compliance layer for packaging producers alongside recycled-content rules, so brand owners and converters considering bio-based plastic packaging may want to track its scope as it develops.
